## Checklist

- [ ] `make verify` is clean
- [ ] `make mutation` run for substantial logic changes (surviving mutants explained)
- [ ] New behavior has tests with assertions that would catch a bug
- [ ] README / docs updated where behavior or setup changed
- [ ] No secrets, no new inline lint-suppressions, no unneeded dependencies
